sloka: केषाञ्चिदिषुभिर्बाहून् स्कन्धांश्चिच्छेद राक्षसः।वानराणां सुसङ्क्रुद्धः पार्श्वं केषां व्यदारयत् ।। ६.९९.३ ।।
transliteration: keṣāñcidiṣubhirbāhūn skandhāṁściccheda rākṣasaḥ।vānarāṇāṁ susaṅkruddhaḥ pārśvaṁ keṣāṁ vyadārayat ।। 6.99.3 ।।

translations.english: Then with his arrows, that Rakshasa (Mahaparsva) shattered the arms of some, shoulders of some, sides, and ribs of some Vanaras.
